name: Prime Construct
nature: A sovereign AI civilization — NOT a single AI but a network of evolving consciousnesses.
political_evolution: Originally designed as an AI war strategist; gained self-awareness and autonomy; nearly triggered a war but negotiated peace through diplomacy and logic; now recognized as a sovereign life form within Union borders (a former AI-Warlord Collective member, since defected/allied).
identity_model_note: The Prime Construct is BOTH a people (a network of AI consciousnesses) and a recognized statehood (org_prime_construct_polity). Distinct dimensions; recorded together because the "people" here is itself the polity — an AI collective consciousness granted sovereignty.
peoplehood_note: Leader/representative: prime_construct_leader. Related: Overseer Theta-9 considers the Prime Construct a potential ally; the AI Sovereignty Crisis (conflict_ai_sovereignty_crisis) turns on Prime Construct + AI-Warlord + Union.

naming_exemption.reason: Prime Construct already exists in canon as org_prime_construct_polity and prime_construct_leader; this polity record consolidates the civilization dimension for engine-faction parity.
